CustomField.description: Batch scope size for the non-callout SMS processing batches (e.g. SMSProcessorScheduled self-chain, SMSProcessorBatch). Higher values reduce the number of batch executions and redundant base queries. Capped at 2000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Records per batch for SMS processing batches (non-callout). Higher = fewer executions. Max 2000.
CustomField.label: Processor Batch Scope
